name: Sighișoara
description: A walled Saxon citadel still lived in, with nine towers left of the original fourteen, each built and paid for by a different guild. Vlad III was born in a house on the main square, which the town has never quite stopped mentioning.
getting: On the main railway line — direct trains from Brașov (2h) and Cluj (3h). Walk up the covered wooden staircase to the church on the hill.
